title: Protected Main
objective: Commit on a notes branch, then check that the current branch is ready to propose.
hint: Commit the README on main, then git switch -c notes, Add-Content, git add, and git commit -q -m "Add second section". Then an if line testing (git branch --show-current) -eq "main", printing Work on a branch first in the if block, and Ready for a pull request: with the branch in the else block.
